Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 15IRH10 Intel Core i5-13420H Metal Laptop


Experience the perfect balance of performance and portability with the Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3. Powered by the robust 13th Gen Intel Core i5-13420H processor, this laptop is engineered to handle demanding multitasking, office workloads, and student projects with seamless speed. Featuring a premium, military-grade durable metal chassis in a sleek Arctic Grey finish, it delivers a high-end feel while remaining lightweight for on-the-go productivity. 


Equipped with 8GB of responsive RAM and a lightning-fast 512GB NVMe SSD, you'll enjoy near-instant boot times and ample storage for all your essential files. The 15.3-inch Full HD display provides crisp, clear visuals with anti-glare technology, making it ideal for long hours of work, streaming, or video conferencing. Upgrade your daily computing experience with a reliable, slim, and stylish powerhouse built to last.
